ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the square photo grid.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Short supporting text shown under the section title. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

FirstTileTitle.helper: Required. Main title shown inside the first square tile. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

FirstTileDescription.helper: Optional. Short description shown inside the first square tile. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

FirstTileBackgroundColor.helper: Choose the background color for the first square tile.

CTAText.helper: Required. Text for the gallery CTA button and the lightbox overlay. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

CTAURL.helper: Required. Select or enter the URL for the full gallery or photo landing page. Local and external URLs are both allowed.

Images.helper: Add gallery images here. The page will show only 3 images at a time. If more than 3 are added, the template randomly chooses 3 each time the page renders.

ImageTitle.helper: Required. Short, clear image title. This is used in the lightbox title and image alt text.
ImageTitle.placeholder: Ribbon Cutting at a Local Business

ImageDescription.helper: Optional. Short caption shown inside the lightbox. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.
ImageDescription.placeholder: A brief note about the photo, event, or business.

ImagePath.helper: Required. Choose an image from the gallery folder. Square or landscape images work best, ideally at least 1200px wide.
